title: Who is on screen for a dialogue page with no speaker
hypothesis: Tagging a dialogue page that has no speaker with who is on screen at that page (PROF. BIRCH, ZIGZAGOON_1 and BIRCHS_BAG for Route 101's "In my BAG! There's a POKé BALL!") lets the model tie map-script lines to the people and objects present (live run 2026-10-16T02-23-17_qwen36-gpu1_sh02 walked toward Birch 30+ times after turn 259 instead of opening the bag at (7,14)), so more runs choose a starter, in fewer turns after reaching Route 101.
notes: Uses the finals incumbent with dialogue-auto-advance-v1 ON, as people-ledger does, because script-line-presence-v1 needs it (its page records carry the tag); the candidate flips only script-line-presence-v1. character-presence-v1 is off in this incumbent, so a standalone screen lists PROF_BIRCH by sprite kind; in the bundle arm of bundle-v-control (where the operator wants this switch; experiments/fixed/bundle-v-control.json is owned by another thread and not edited here) character-presence-v1 and dialogue-auto-advance-v1 are on and Birch is named. Activation: the first unattributed page in recorded auto-advance runs (sh02 turn 259, show turn 212) is Birch's "H-help me!" right after ROUTE_101. A checkpoint design should start on Route 101 before the rescue. Provisional source.commit is replaced by the merge SHA when it lands.
